violation_type.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

violation_type.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

finding_variants.text: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.
Multiple caregivers at the operation has online only CPR training.
Two employees do not have face to face  training in CPR.
The caregiver CPR training was completed on line.
Three staff members had CPR training that was taken online, therefore does not adhere with the guidelines for American Heart Association.
There was a caregiver file reviewed that had only had an online CPR certificate without any hands-on training.
